overall_fit_percentage.description: Overall fit score based on overlap between profile and JD requirements

core_requirements_match_percentage.description: Percentage match of critical core requirements

requirement.description: Core requirement extracted from the JD

user_match.description: How the user matches this requirement based on their profile

requirement.description: JD requirement that the user lacks direct experience in

parallel_exposure.description: Relevant parallel or related industry/tool exposure the user has

learning_plan.description: Factual and proactive plan to learn this missing requirement fast

key_analysis_points.description: Bulleted key analytical takeaways regarding the alignment of the profile and role

skill.description: Key skill or quality the hiring manager is looking for (e.g. 'Data Engineering', 'Team Leadership')

match_percentage.description: 0 to 100 percentage match against the user's profile

justification.description: Brief explanation of why the user has this match percentage

key_skills_match.description: 4-5 key skills or qualities the hiring manager is looking for, and the user's match against them

keyword_match_percentage.description: Estimated percentage of JD keywords covered in the resume

formatting_compliance_score.description: Adherence score to ATS layout rules (single-column, standard headings, no tables)

star_method_coverage_percentage.description: Percentage of work experience bullets written using STAR (Situation, Task, Action, Result) format

ats_friendly_score.description: Overall composite ATS compatibility score based on keyword match, format compliance, and action verbs

formatting_suggestions.description: Specific recommendations to ensure parsing compatibility for systems like Workday or Taleo

summary.description: The professional summary tailored for the JD.

core_competencies.description: Formatted bullet points for the core competencies match. E.g. '* **[Skill] ([Match]%)**: [Justification]'

jd_keywords.description: List of JD keywords matching the profile.

achievements.description: Measurable bullet points starting with an action verb.

education.description: List of education entries exactly matching profile.
